articles.title: 谷歌AI助手Tasks免费开放

items.title_en: Multi-Branch Transformer
items.summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MB
items.title_cn: 多分支Transformer
items.note: 探索并行组合完整Transformer块的分支式扩展路径，与加宽加深互补。

items.title_en: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
items.summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarnes
items.title_cn: ForceHarness：将力与物理转化为冻结前沿模型的动作
items.note: 让仅API可用的冻结多模态模型通过力反馈闭环控制机器人操作。

items.title_en: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
items.summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce MedJev, a system one vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multi
items.title_cn: MedJev：面向快速有效医学图像理解的系统一视觉语言决策模型
items.note: 跳过推理文本生成，将医学图像问题与候选答案直接映射为决策。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.summary: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed archite
items.title_cn: 权重空间编程不需要Transformer
items.note: 研究LLM手写权重时，是否仍需沿用为梯度训练设计的Transformer架构。

items.title_en: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
items.summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video
items.title_cn: ResWAM：学习变化而非不变，面向世界动作模型
items.note: 只监督未来观测中的变化部分，避免模型只学会复制静态背景。

items.summary: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent
items.title_cn: Sage S2.1 Flash技术报告
items.note: 3200亿参数专家混合模型，用专用编码器处理分子、序列与光谱等科学数据。

items.title_en: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
items.summary: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projection
items.title_cn: K2-Horizon：前沿开源语言模型舰队
items.note: 发布0.9B到375B的六款全开源模型，并提出混合价值注意力增强推理。

items.title_en: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
items.summary: Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives. We present AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly
items.title_cn: AllocFlow：从原始市场数据端到端生成组合交易动作

items.title_en: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
items.summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With In
items.title_cn: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的AI基准测试
items.note: 按医疗角色与AI能力组织基准，首版从388个候选中严格筛选出4个。

items.title_en: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
items.summary: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be
items.title_cn: SPILLWAY：分离目标准入与净化，防御工具型智能体的提示注入
items.note: 把动作去向的准入判断与内容净化分开，减少对模型读攻击文本的依赖。

items.title_en: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.summary: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. It operates in a closed loop: observing the environment, interpreting user intent, reasoning about the task, invoking skills and to
items.title_cn: 展望智能体机器人：机器人系统的新时代
items.note: 论述基础模型加智能体外壳的闭环范式，替代逐任务训练专用策略。

items.title_en: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.summary: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajec
items.title_cn: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉语言动作基础模型
items.note: 端到端整合感知、记忆与多步推理，支持2D界面和3D模拟世界交互。

items.title_en: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
items.summary: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including sc
items.title_cn: VibePrevisBench：评估Blender中4D场景生成的智能体编程
items.note: 用242个任务检验编码智能体能否按简报重建4D场景并渲染代理视频。

items.title_en: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.summary: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest
items.title_cn: MIRIX-2.0：多智能体记忆系统
items.note: 兼顾准确与高效的多智能体长期记忆系统，在多个问答基准上领先。

items.title_en: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that accep
items.title_cn: MMFlash：面向视觉语言模型的更快推测解码
items.note: 提出视觉依赖度指标，研究扩散草稿模型在多模态推测解码中的接受率。

items.title_en: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 doma
items.title_cn: SO-Arena：基准测试系统一模型的能力谱系与决策可靠性
items.note: 跨11个领域刻画快速决策模型的能力广度与决策可靠性，而非只看总分。

items.title_en: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
items.summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. Prior work therefore conditions video generation on layouts that specify vehicle motion, providing control over surrounding vehicles but requiring their future trajectories a
items.title_cn: BirdDreams：联合透视与鸟瞰视频生成的合理反应式驾驶世界模型
items.note: 同时生成透视与BEV视频，兼顾周围车辆运动合理性与自车轨迹精确控制。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fu
items.title_cn: Duo：面向全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.note: 提出互惠世界模型，边持续感知视听输入边实时回应用户。

items.title_en: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--grou
items.title_cn: G-STAR：面向深度压缩自回归生成的组缩放令牌容量
items.note: 基于乘积量化推导组大小与空间压缩因子的平方关系，平衡质量与速度。

items.title_en: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to s
items.title_cn: PhysLoop：利用LLM物理意识自我改进视频生成模型
items.note: 构建统一框架，用大语言模型的物理知识为视频生成提供细粒度监督。

items.title_en: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
items.summary: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, depen
items.title_cn: 从结构化教科书扩展数学证明监督
items.note: 将2118本大学数学教材转为约38万条保留章节与证明依赖结构的监督记录。

items.title_en: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
items.summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce
items.title_cn: SteerDistill：通过闭环教师引导量化LLM智能体
items.note: 针对量化智能体偏离任务要求的行为偏差，用闭环教师引导进行修正。

items.title_en: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formu
items.title_cn: 通过强化学习激励大语言模型自我学习
items.note: 研究模型自主检索、研读并即时应用长文档知识的能力，并构建相应任务。

items.title_en: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
items.summary: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how eviden
items.title_cn: 少读多解：AI智能体的令牌高效稀疏阅读
items.note: 可复用阅读控制层，按需准入内容，减少整篇读取带来的令牌与延迟开销。

items.title_en: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific pred
items.title_cn: 面向提示自适应与成本感知LLM推理的集成路由
items.note: 结合软聚类与模型预测，按提示自适应选择单模型或集成以平衡质量与成本。

items.title_en: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
items.summary: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation u
items.title_cn: 通过条件偏移实现少步流式视频生成
items.note: 扩展APEX，用条件偏移在生成器内估计速度场，免去额外假分数网络。

items.title_en: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
items.summary: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectori
items.title_cn: 别只信记忆：证据链接记忆减少LLM智能体的记忆诱发退化
items.note: 让记忆经验附带来源轨迹证据，减少智能体误用错误教训导致的性能下降。

items.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world tran
items.title_cn: 面向智能体机器人操作的世界上下文学习
items.note: 利用上下文学习迁移语义任务步骤与物体角色，而非绑定视觉外观。

items.title_en: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
items.summary: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop directio
items.title_cn: Tree-Ising：用比特级Ising编辑修复语言模型
items.note: 将权重空间修复建模为BF16权重上的稀疏离散优化，削弱推理循环。

items.title_en: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
items.summary: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbon
items.title_cn: 一表多查：跨生成、插补与预测的通用表格模型基准
items.note: 统一56个数据集与20个能力维度，比较单一模型能否同时胜任三类表格任务。

items.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous ta
items.title_cn: 面向通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征学习
items.note: 让具身模型摆脱传感器特定物理，统一利用多种异构触觉传感器。

items.title_en: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disci
items.title_cn: Sage-Taiyi：面向科学发现的元认知架构
items.note: 通过显式监控与调控修正对证据和假设的理解，自适应选择研究方向与方法。

items.title_en: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to
items.title_cn: WorldFoundry：面向世界智能的统一基础设施
items.note: 定义生成式世界模型为维护持久历史表征并响应交互的预测动力系统。

items.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
items.summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets
items.title_cn: Infrathon：面向真实长时程AI基础设施优化的语言智能体基准
items.note: 用24小时预算的150次运行检验前沿智能体能否持续优化真实AI基础设施。

items.title_en: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. Fi
items.title_cn: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 把观测状态而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象，改善视觉智能体的工具使用。

huggingface.models_summary: 这几个热门模型集中在多模态方向：图文理解、文生图、图生视频、音频处理都有覆盖，说明模型正从只处理文字转向同时处理图片、视频和声音。同时出现 Small、4B 这类较小规模命名，反映轻量版本受关注。想跟进AI圈或备考的人，可留意多模态任务类型和模型规模这两条线索，但多数项目页缺描述，需自己查证具体能力。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几条主线：一是智能体（Agent），包括工具调用安全、长期记忆、网页稀疏阅读、成本路由和基础设施长时程优化；二是世界模型与视频生成，强调物理一致性、4D场景和驾驶仿真；三是机器人与具身智能，力触觉、灵巧操作和视觉语言动作模型很热；四是模型效率，如推测解码、量化和少步生成；五是科学、医疗与数学等专业应用。新手可记住关键词：Agent、世界模型、VLA、多模态、推理、量化、基准测试。
